texts.about_this_item: 8in1 Fillets Pro Digest are premium dried chicken fillets with a unique Nutri-Center filling, a concentrate designed to support your dog's well-being. Suitable for adult dogs of all breeds, and thanks to their low fat content (4.5 %) they can be given between meals. Fillets Pro Digest are enriched with powdered chicory root, which supports digestion. Complementary food for dogs.
texts.ingredient_information: Meat and animal derivatives (chicken meat 80 %), vegetable protein extracts, cereals, minerals, derivatives of vegetable origin (powdered chicory root 0.25 %), glycerine, sorbitol. Analytical constituents: protein 63 %, fat 4.5 %, crude ash 4 %.
texts.feeding_instructions: Complementary snack to the daily food; give as a treat or reward. Always provide fresh drinking water.
